name: Face proposals
description: Detects faces in new photos (preview only) and lands unconfirmed media.face_region proposals; you answer them in Photos. Answered regions are never touched or re-proposed again.
prompt: When new photos arrive, look at each one's preview and mark where the faces are as normalized boxes with confidence scores. Never guess who anyone is — I confirm identities myself in the Photos app. Never touch a region I've already answered: confirming it, rejecting it, or deliberately leaving it unnamed all mean I am finished with that face.

vault.why: Reads new photos' preview/thumb derivatives, detects face regions, and stages unconfirmed proposals for the owner's confirm loop in Photos (issue #299 phase 3). Also drains the on-demand enrichment queue (issue #352 phase 3/4) so a 'detect faces now' ask from the app jumps the backlog.
